sources.events_sample.json: GET https://api.gemini.com/v1/prediction-markets/events?category=Sports&status=active&limit=10 (two of the ten returned events kept: NBA-2610232300-MIN-ORL-M and EPL-2610231900-NFO-IPS-M)

trimming: Every kept value is byte-identical to the capture; only keys, nested child events and contracts were removed.
Contracts: rich-text description, termsAndConditionsUrl, color, imageUrl and quantity/price increment fields dropped.
Events: imageUrl, socialImageUrl, featuredImageUrl, termsLink, eventTags, sourceDetails and volumeDelta24hPct dropped.
NBA spread child keeps 3 of its contracts (ORL1, MIN1, and the one-sided ORL26 with no bid); NBA total child keeps 1 (O209).
EPL keeps its spread child with 1 contract (NFO1); its total-goals child was dropped.
pagination is the capture's own (total 764), not recomputed for the trimmed list.
synthetic: tests/test_gemini.py derives edge cases (wrong date, closed, combo, malformed prices, duplicates, period scope, three-way NBA) from deep copies of these events; each such copy is labelled synthetic where it is built.
